name: litellm
description: The fastest, litest AI Gateway. Rust core with Python SDK. Call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging [Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI, VertexAI, vLLM, Nvidia NIM]
one_liner: A single switchboard that lets a company plug in any AI model from any provider using one simple format, while tracking what it's spending and who's using what.
buyer: A CTO or engineering lead at a startup juggling multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock) who needs one place to control cost, access, and reliability.
business_use_cases: A startup self-hosts it to swap AI providers without rewriting application code, and to stop unexpected AI bills by setting per-team spend limits.
An agency managing AI features for several clients runs one gateway to track usage and bill each client accurately.
An enterprise IT team deploys it with guardrails to block risky prompts and PII leakage across every internal AI tool.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed, hosted version of the gateway with dashboards and support, priced per seat or per team.
Charge a small usage markup for handling enterprise-grade guardrails, logging, and compliance features.

steal_this: Stand up a hosted, managed instance of this for small AI-building startups who don't want to run infrastructure, and charge monthly for the dashboard and support.
